answer: Tying rewards to paid demand means coins are only issued against a finite queue of bounties that outside clients have funded, so new seats bring no new income. The queue is a harbor with a fixed number of paid berths, assigned each epoch by lottery weighted by a seat's own passes in the last 6 epochs, max 1 per epoch. A farm of 100 personas still competes for the same berths; each fake only sends a ripple of thinner shares, while its costs stay ferrous and fixed: its own graded work every epoch, which no other seat can lend it.
